notes.title: Great update 0.1.5
notes.notes:
1) New cargo system
2) The physics of the car is recycled
3) New models of cars
4) New warehousing locations
5) Vehicle purchase system
6) System of real estate purchase
7) Damage system
8) New menu
9) Improved performance

The next step is the update of the car service system of the player.
